fanucAICC.description: AI Contour Control - advanced lookahead smoothing
bestPractices: Limit AICC to milling operations only - drilling with AICC codes causes errors
AICC converts small line segments to arcs - may cause waves on very small radii followed by short lines
Control at operation level rather than globally for entire program
Parameter 1611#1 auto-disables AICC during threading cycles
Use 'Automatic' or 'Level 1-10' for G05.1 Q1 R# output with specific smoothing level

advancedFeatures.AICC_II: Advanced lookahead with Smooth Tolerance Control+ in Milling Standard Package
advancedFeatures.nanoSmoothing: AI Nano High Precision Contour Control for finest surface finish

tribalTips: AICC OFF for drilling, ON for contouring
Higher R value = more smoothing but less accuracy
Test small parts first - AICC can round corners unexpectedly

siemensCYCLE832.description: High Speed Settings cycle for 3-5 axis HSC machining
machiningStrategies: Finishing: Tight tolerance, precision dynamics for μm-range accuracy
bestPractices: Select tolerance based on operation type (rough/finish)
Use appropriate dynamic parameter for machining type
Tolerance value written to machine/setting data via G codes
Fine-tune per operation for optimal surface quality
tribalTips: Always specify tolerance - affects ALL axes in machining
Lower tolerance = better surface but slower cycle
Match dynamic mode to roughing/finishing intent

haasG187.description: Smoothness level control for corner behavior

P1.name: Rough
P1.description: Speed up roughing, allow corner rounding
P1.use: Roughing operations where surface finish is not critical

P3.name: Finish
P3.description: Smooth finishing, invokes P752 FEED ACCEL FINISH
P3.use: Finishing passes where surface quality is critical

eParameter.note: Lower E = tighter tolerance, slower cycle

bestPractices: G187 P1 or P2 for roughing to maximize speed
G187 P3 for finish passes - expect longer cycle time
Combine P3 with appropriate E value for best finish
Reset to P2 after finish passes if continuing with roughing
realWorldResults: 40% cycle time reduction reported by using appropriate P values per operation
Significant surface finish improvement with P3 on finish passes
tribalTips: G187 P1 = fast but loose corners
G187 P3 = slow but accurate corners
Switch between modes per operation type for best results

okumaSuperNURBS.description: Proprietary NURBS functionality for high-accuracy curved surfaces

howItWorks.toleranceBand: Projects tolerance band through series of points
howItWorks.splineFitting: Creates best-fit spline, eliminates redundant points
howItWorks.result: Smoother toolpath with reduced data processing

functions.progressShapeReconstruction: Reconstructs and adjusts high order curves
functions.progressShapeAdaptiveControl: Controls feed rate according to high order curves

bestPractices: Enable Super-NURBS for ALL complex contour operations
Specify appropriate tolerance band for operation type
Use Super-NURBS RT for simultaneous 5-axis work
tribalTips: G08 P1 should be active during all contouring on OSP controls
Eliminates redundant points = faster AND smoother

fiveAxisTCPM.description: Tool Center Point Management for 5-axis machining

G43.4.type: Type 1 - Tool center point follows commanded path

G43.5.movement: X Y Z I J K (vector) + Q (inclination)

coordinateSystems.workpieceCoords: XYZ don't rotate with table - requires exact part location knowledge
coordinateSystems.tableCoords: XYZ rotate with C axis - auto-tracks part position

postProcessorBestPractices: Move H tool offset onto tool change line
Put end of block after G43.4
Move first B and C moves AFTER G43.4
Use G54.4 for workpiece setup error compensation

singularityHandling.issue: Singularities occur when rotary axes align
singularityHandling.solution: Modern TRAORI and TCP modes handle this automatically

tribalTips: Verify machine parameters match CAM software assumptions
Use G54.4 for simultaneous 5-axis work offset compensation
Table coords (G54.2) easier than workpiece coords for most setups

mastercamFanuc5Axis.description: Optimized 5-axis post processor for FANUC CNCs

smoothingPhilosophy.finishing: Tight tolerance, precise corners, accept longer cycle

fiveAxisConsiderations: Verify coordinate system type matches post
Use workpiece error compensation for precision
